Independent review of published W08 head `79d44c84fe550741bbd8de00c119c48560f30bc1` confirms the Plain Flour correction, with one minor authoring-process finding, W08-PF-PROCESS-001 (also W08-PF-WORKFLOW-001).

The published `reports/all_unmatched_20261107/worker-08/successors/issue-1227-plain-flour-v1/provenance/author.py`, SHA-256 `1790bb6525e047fde7158a4f84ab9a623de43ba8b4a85aa96fc09b5244d8b0c0`, line 46 directly appends the curation event. The native validated writer was used, and the event is truthful and schema-valid. The focused curate-yaml-record skill section 5 requires `record_curation_event(..., llm_assisted=True)` before the guarded writer. This is a process deviation, not an unsupported chemical identity or a malformed-event claim.

Bounded correction: preserve the published artifact and its history unchanged. Add an immutable documented replay from the same predecessor, constructing the existing truthful event through the native event helper and guarded writer, then compare the complete resulting event and payload. Do not append a second scientific event to an otherwise unchanged record. If the helper produces a necessary semantic difference, report it explicitly and review it before selecting a successor. Retain the original history timestamps/attribution as historical facts rather than claiming a new scientific review occurred.

The independent packet is `workers/w09/worktree/.temp/w08-plain-flour-final-independent-v1`, handoff SHA-256 `18b584da35922845905ea7a1f1076b28ead45bb45f5a43acd26c31954ba17f93`, manifest `cd6e9558844a53a5201aa9071dfac1a27750400db900829ad2cb3bbd103c7976`. The existing PF-LINEAGE-001 historical quotation referral is already filed separately. Trypticase/Bacto admission remains FAILED/HELD; this review confers no owner, role or export approval.
